messages:
Sam L: hey team — quick Q from my trip yesterday. Took a short ferry (Dover→Calais) and only got a tiny paper stub, no VAT/invoice. Can I just snap a photo of the stub for reimbursement? Also, I left after lunch — do I claim full per diem or pro-rate for the travel day?
Jordan (People Ops): hey Sam :wave: yes please attach the photo of the paper stub in Expensify. We need some proof of payment for goods/services. If the vendor can provide an email receipt you can add that too.
Sam L: awesome, thanks. For the photo, is a handwritten stamp + timestamp on the stub ok? it has date, route, and amount but no itemization.
Nina F (Finance): that's fine generally — as long as the amount, date and merchant are visible. For tax/recordkeeping we prefer itemized receipts, but transport stubs are common exceptions. If it's >€200 we may ping you for extra details.
Alex W: also fyi if you paid in EUR but our card/corp currency is USD, enter the original currency in the form and Expensify will do the conversion. Include a screenshot of the bank/credit card charge if the stub is borderline.
Sam L: great — thanks. And per diem? our travel day rules are fuzzy to me.
Jordan (People Ops): per diem is pro-rated on travel days when your trip starts/ends mid-day. Rule of thumb: full per diem if away >12 hours, half if between 6–12 hours, none if <6. For ferry/train legs that start after noon, you can claim half-day. I'll paste the short policy snippet below.
Jordan (People Ops): ```Per diem pro‑rata: departure day and return day are pro‑rated based on total hours away. Use full/half/none tiers. For multi-city same-day travel, add notes with times.```
Sam L: perfect — I'll put half-day and attach the stub photo + card screenshot. Anything else to avoid delays?
Nina F (Finance): add a short note like "Dover→Calais ferry, personal payment; card charged later" and tag the expense category as Travel:Transport. If you don't have the boarding stamp photo, mark it as "missing receipt" and ping Jordan for approval — she'll add a confirmation comment.
Sam L: ok added everything, submitted. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
ExpensesBot: Helpful links: Expense guide — https://company.docs/expenses/travel ; How to attach foreign receipts — https://company.docs/expenses/receipts
Jordan (People Ops): thanks Sam — approved on our side, Nina will finalize on finance queue. Closing thread once payment clears. :white_check_mark:
